headword: {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}
reading: さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ

definitions.gloss: the athlete judged to have performed best in a game, tournament, or season; the Most Valuable Player (MVP)
definitions.explanation: An official award in professional and amateur sports honoring the player whose performance was judged to have contributed the most to a team's success over a given game, series, tournament, or season. Used across virtually every competitive sport in Japan — professional baseball, soccer, basketball, volleyball, and high-school tournaments alike. Often abbreviated MVP (read エムブイピー) in Japanese sports media.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: I was chosen as this year's Most Valuable Player.

examples.japanese: {決勝戦|けっしょうせん}の{最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}は{彼|かれ}だった。
examples.english: He was the MVP of the final.

examples.japanese: {大谷|おおたに}{選手|せんしゅ}は{今|こん}シーズンの{最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}{賞|しょう}を{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: Ohtani won this season's Most Valuable Player award.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{二年|にねん}{連続|れんぞく}でリーグの{最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}に{選|えら}ばれるという{快挙|かいきょ}を{成|な}し{遂|と}げた。
examples.english: She achieved the remarkable feat of being voted the league's Most Valuable Player for two years in a row.

notes:
Composed of {最|さい}- (the most, supreme) + {優秀|ゆうしゅう} (excellent, outstanding) + {選手|せんしゅ} (athlete, player). Literally "the most outstanding player." The standard Japanese rendering of "MVP."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}{賞|しょう}: the MVP award / Most Valuable Player Award
- {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}に{選|えら}ばれる: to be selected as MVP
- {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}を{獲得|かくとく}する: to win the MVP title
- {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}{賞|しょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}する: to win the MVP award
- シーズンMVP / {年間|ねんかん}{最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}: season MVP, annual MVP

USAGE:
Japanese sports media often use the English abbreviation MVP (read エムブイピー) interchangeably with {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}. On NHK and in official league announcements, the full Japanese form is usually preferred; in casual sports journalism and fan conversation, "MVP" is equally common.

RELATED AWARD TERMS:
- {最優秀新人選手|さいゆうしゅうしんじんせんしゅ} / {新人王|しんじんおう}: Rookie of the Year
- {優秀選手|ゆうしゅうせんしゅ}: outstanding player (a step below MVP; several may be chosen)
- {首位打者|しゅいだしゃ}: batting champion (baseball)
- {最多勝|さいたしょう}: most wins (baseball pitcher)
- {得点王|とくてんおう}: top scorer (soccer)
- {敢闘賞|かんとうしょう}: fighting-spirit award
- {殊勲賞|しゅくんしょう}: distinguished-service award

REGISTER:
Formal and written. Appears on trophies, in press releases, and in official team communications. Casual fans will also say MVP directly.
